Container.Name: flex-emulator
Container.Overview: Makes a non-Flex radio (Hermes Lite 2 in Thetis, IC-7300, anything with CAT, rigctld or TCI) look like a FlexRadio on your network, so a 4O3A Antenna Genius, Tuner Genius or Power Genius follows it.[br][br]Needs Host networking: the Flex discovery broadcast must reach your LAN and accessories connect to TCP port 4992 on this server. Open the WebUI and sign in with any user name and the password you set below.[br][br]Independent hobby project, not affiliated with FlexRadio, Icom, the Hermes Lite project, 4O3A or anyone else. Developed with AI. Use at your own risk. GPL-3.0.
Container.Requires: Host networking. Set a settings-page password before starting.

Config.Name: Settings page password
Config.Description: Required. Password for the settings page (any user name works).

Config.Name: Settings and log
Config.Description: Where config.json and flex-emulator.log are kept.

Config.Name: Settings page address
Config.Description: Address and port for the settings page. Change the port if 8992 is taken.

Config.Name: USB radio (optional)
Config.Description: Only for a radio plugged into this server by USB (e.g. IC-7300 on CI-V). Set to the device path, e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0, or leave empty.
